standard_prerequisites.name: The bijection of the space of a gerbe with the space of its base and the sobriety of decent algebraic spaces

core_obligations: Reduce to the substack: for an irreducible closed subset take the reduced induced closed substack, which is decent because the immersion is representable and whose inertia is quasi-compact as a base change, so it satisfies the same hypotheses (proof lines 10581-10598)

Reduce to a gerbe: inside the reduced stack there is a dense open substack that is a gerbe, so one may assume the stack itself is a gerbe over an algebraic space with quasi-compact space and quasi-compact inertia (proof lines 10599-10610)

Conclude sobriety: the space of the gerbe is homeomorphic to the space of that algebraic space, which is decent, so it is sober and the irreducible closed subset has a generic point (proof lines 10611-10617)
proof_roadmap: 对不可约闭子集 T 取既约诱导闭子栈 Z：Z 仍 decent、惯性仍准紧 ⇒ 约化到「既约 + 空间不可约」。
由开层命题取稠密开子栈 U ⊂ X 使 X|_U 是 gerbe ⇒ 可设 X 本身是 X 上 gerbe。
|X| ≅ |X|，而 X 是 decent 代数空间 ⇒ |X| sober ⇒ T 有泛点。
difficulty_reason: The counted statement shows that the space of a decent algebraic stack with quasi-compact inertia is sober (author proposition at source lines 10574-10579, label proposition-decent-sober). The proof (source lines 10581-10618) reduces to the reduced induced closed substack on an irreducible closed subset, which inherits decency and quasi-compact inertia, then to a dense open gerbe, and concludes by identifying the space of the gerbe with the space of a decent algebraic space, which is sober (proof lines 10581-10617). The two reductions and the identification of spaces are the substance. H3.
